id.meaning: Interactable id taken from the URL path.

body.meaning: Raw JSON or key=value child body.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed literal outcomes are enumerated; child first_missing_signal may pass through as <child signal text> and invocation errors as caduceus-harmonia-command-failed:<error text>. Child error text such as interactable-unknown-id <id> may instead be in body.
